items.name: notification-toaster
items.title: Notification Toaster
items.description: In-app toast region that renders the notifications the operating system refused or that arrived while the tab was focused.

items.name: request-permission-button
items.title: Request Permission Button
items.description: Asks for notification permission from inside the click, which is the only place Safari allows it.

items.name: notification-permission-badge
items.title: Notification Permission Badge
items.description: Live badge for the four permission states, including the case where the browser has no Notifications API.

items.name: notification-action-list
items.title: Notification Action List
items.description: Renders a notification's action buttons and surfaces the ones the browser refused to draw rather than dropping them.

items.name: counter-badge
items.title: Counter Badge
items.description: Unread count with an overflow cap, ringed so it stays legible over an icon or an avatar.
